xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5337: Markdown preview: every relative link opens a 404 dashboard URL (/conv/fort3d.md) instead of the linked file

plan.title: Markdown preview: every relative link opens a 404 dashboard URL (/conv/fort3d.md) instead of the linked file
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Every relative link in a Markdown preview (code pane Preview, editor pane Preview, Docs pane, cockpit dig tabs) renders as <a href="fort3d.md" target="_blank">, because MarkdownTab passes no cwd, resolveMarkdownFileLinkTarget returns null for relative paths without one, and ChatMarkdown falls through to TranscriptLink. The browser resolves the href against /conv/<id> and opens a 404 tab. The operator's repro (chat chip -> editor pane -> Preview -> fort3d.md) hits this on all 93 links of a docs index.
narratives.Proposal: Add a total href classifier and a root-relative path resolver (pure), a guard in ChatMarkdown that renders unresolved document-relative hrefs as inert text, and a docLocation { rootId, path } prop on MarkdownTab/ChatMarkdown. With a location, relative links render MarkdownDocLink, which checks existence with one cached listDir per folder and opens files through deck.openBeside({ rootId, path, line, preview: true }) like a single click in the Files tree, reveals folders in the Files dock, and shows missing/outside targets as not found. Headings get data-heading-slug and #fragment links scroll inside the preview. The code pane passes its rootId/path; the editor pane maps its absolute path to an explorer root with a new explorerLocationForPath. Full detail: .pan/drafts/pan-5337.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Exposing PRD/STATE document paths from the server so Docs pane and dig-tab links resolve (they stay inert)
- Resolving root-relative links ('/docs/x.md') against the explorer root inside a file preview
- Changing how chat file chips (MarkdownFileLink) open files (PAN-5284 child D2)
- Scrolling a newly opened target to its #heading
- Link handling inside the experimental Streamdown renderer beyond the chat guard
- Image sources in previews
- Opening a Markdown link target in its Preview view (PAN-5340)
- Any new server route, RPC, contract schema or npm dependency
- Writing location.hash or otherwise changing the page URL on any preview link click
- Adding rules to components/CommandDeck/styles/command-deck.module.css

autoDecisions.summary: Previews get a new docLocation prop on MarkdownTab/ChatMarkdown instead of a cwd (issue's fallback 'resolveLink' option, specialized).
autoDecisions.rationale: A cwd turns links into chat file chips, runs bare-text path detection over prose and sends one RPC per token, and the path regexes reject 'levels/' and names with spaces.

autoDecisions.summary: Links open through deck.openBeside with preview: true, the call the Files tree's single click makes.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires 'the same way the Files tree opens it'; PAN-5287 already merged openBeside, so PAN-5290 is not a dependency.

autoDecisions.summary: Opening a Markdown link target in its Preview view is split out to PAN-5340; this plan opens targets exactly as the Files tree does (Edit view).
autoDecisions.rationale: It needs a new pane field across six more files (over the 25-file plan limit and into PAN-5290's lines) and must not apply when the link carries a line, because the line reveal needs Monaco mounted.

autoDecisions.summary: The editor pane maps its absolute path to an explorer root on the client (explorerLocationForPath, rules 4-5 of rootIdForConversation); no match means inert links.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator's repro goes through the editor pane; the mapping reuses the existing rules and needs no server change.

autoDecisions.summary: Existence is checked eagerly with one listDir per (root, folder), cached 10 s.
autoDecisions.rationale: The not-found state must show before a click (requirement 7) and no new RPC is allowed; listDir also tells files from folders.

autoDecisions.summary: Docs pane and dig tabs (no file location) render relative links as inert text; the PRD path is not exposed from the server.
autoDecisions.rationale: Requirement 8 allows plain text when the location is unknown; PlanningResponse carries no path.

autoDecisions.summary: Root-relative hrefs (/conv/123) count as absolute in the chat guard.
autoDecisions.rationale: Transcripts link dashboard routes; treating them as relative would break working links.

autoDecisions.summary: Heading slugs are a local GitHub-style function plus a remark plugin, applied only to located previews; fragment clicks scroll inside the preview and never set location.hash.
autoDecisions.rationale: No slug library is installed (NFR-2) and requirement 2 forbids changing the page URL.

items.title: Add the pure href classifier and root-relative path resolver (markdownDocLinks.ts)

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/pan-5337.md). Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/markdownDocLinks.ts exporting DocHref, classifyDocHref, isDocumentRelativeHref, ResolvedDocPath, resolveDocPath and docDirOf with exactly the rules in WI-1 (trim, unwrap <>, '#' -> fragment, leading '/' or Windows drive -> absolute, a 'scheme:' prefix -> absolute EXCEPT when the rest after the first ':' is only digits[:digits] (so 'fort3d.md:12' stays a relative file with line 12, as hasExternalScheme does in markdown-links.ts), everything else relative with ?query dropped, #hash split, :line[:col] suffix, #L<n>C<m> fallback, trailingSlash flag; resolveDocPath skips '' and '.', '..' pops or returns outside, a leading '~' segment returns outside). No React imports. Write the 14 named tests from WI-1 and add src/lib/__tests__/markdownDocLinks.test.ts to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt in sorted position.

items.title: Given href 'fort3d.md', classifyDocHref returns kind 'relative' with path 'fort3d.md'; given '/conv/123', 'https://x' or 'mailto:a@b' it returns kind 'absolute'; given '#Install' it returns kind 'fragment' with slug 'Install'

Given 'fort3d.md:12', classifyDocHref returns kind 'relative' with path 'fort3d.md' and line 12 (not 'absolute'); given 'x.md:12:3' or 'x.md#L12C3' it returns path 'x.md', line 12, column 3; given 'x.md#intro' it returns path 'x.md' with no line

resolveDocPath('docs', 'fort3d.md') returns { kind: 'inside', path: 'docs/fort3d.md' }, resolveDocPath('docs/x', '../a.md') returns 'docs/a.md', and resolveDocPath('docs', '../../a.md') and resolveDocPath('docs', '~/a.md') return { kind: 'outside' }
The test file is listed in scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt and `npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/markdownDocLinks.test.ts` exits 0 from src/dashboard/frontend

Add the docLocation prop to ChatMarkdown: relative links via MarkdownDocLink, heading slugs and in-preview fragment scroll

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3, wiring part (decisions D1, D7, D8). Add `docLocation?: { rootId: string; path: string }` to ChatMarkdownProps; pass it to makeComponents and add docLocation?.rootId/docLocation?.path to the useMemo deps. In the a component, before the existing resolveMarkdownFileLinkMeta branch: classifyDocHref(href); when docLocation is set and kind is 'relative' return <MarkdownDocLink rootId fromDir={docDirOf(docLocation.path)} target>; when docLocation is set and kind is 'fragment' return <a href={`#${slug}`} className={styles.mdLink} onClick={scrollToHeading(slug)}>, where scrollToHeading is a module-level helper in ChatMarkdown.tsx (preventDefault; closest [data-testid='markdown-tab'] from event.currentTarget; query [data-heading-slug=CSS.escape(slug)] then headingSlug(slug); scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); never touch location.hash). Add remarkHeadingSlugs to remarkPlugins only when docLocation is set. Follow the WI-2 implementation checkpoint if the data-heading-slug attribute does not reach the DOM. Extend ChatMarkdown.relative-links.test.tsx with 'adds data-heading-slug to headings in a located preview', 'adds no data-heading-slug in chat', 'scrolls to the heading on a fragment click without changing location.hash', 'routes a relative link to MarkdownDocLink when docLocation is set'.
